description: Time selection criteria parameter class codes

codes.name: Fri
codes.description: An indicator that Friday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.

codes.name: Mon
codes.description: An indicator that Monday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.

codes.name: Prefend
codes.description: An indicator that there is a preferred end time for the appointment request, service or resource.

codes.name: Prefstart
codes.description: An indicator that there is a preferred start time for the appointment request, service or resource.

codes.name: Sat
codes.description: An indicator that Saturday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.

codes.name: Sun
codes.description: An indicator that Sunday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.

codes.name: Thu
codes.description: An indicator that Thursday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.

codes.name: Tue
codes.description: An indicator that Tuesday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.

codes.name: Wed
codes.description: An indicator that Wednesday is or is not preferred for the day on which the appointment will occur.
